items.title: 7.2.1 Instantaneous (ek lamhe ki) aur average (ausat) rate (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.2.1, printed pages 146-147.

blocks.title: Instantaneous rate
blocks.text: Kisi interval (waqt ka hissa) ke dauran kisi ek instant (lamha) ki rate ko instantaneous rate kehte hain.

blocks.title: Average rate
blocks.text: Average rate (ausat rate) do specific times (khaas waqt) ke darmiyan reaction ki rate hai, yani poore time period par rate.
Kisi bhi interval mein average aur instantaneous rate sirf ek instant par barabar hoti hain. Shuru mein instantaneous rate average se zyada hoti hai, aur interval ke aakhir mein average se kam.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 7.1
blocks.problem: Haber process mein ammonia banne ka reaction: N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g). i. 1.0 min ke baad instantaneous rate nikalein. ii. 1.0 aur 4.0 minute ke darmiyan ammonia banne ki average rate kya hai, jab ammonia ki concentration 1.0 min par 3.5 mol dm⁻³ aur 4.0 min par 6.2 mol dm⁻³ hai?
steps: Given: [NH₃] = 3.5 mol dm⁻³ (1.0 min par) aur 6.2 mol dm⁻³ (4.0 min par)
Required: (i) 1.0 min par instantaneous rate (ii) 1.0 se 4.0 min tak average rate
i. 1.0 min par instantaneous rate = ΔC/Δt = 2.7 mol dm⁻³ / 1 min = 2.7 mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹
ΔC = Δ[NH₃] = (6.2 − 3.5) mol dm⁻³ = 2.7 mol dm⁻³
Rate of formation of NH₃ = ΔC/Δt = 2.7 mol dm⁻³ / 3.0 min = 0.90 mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹
blocks.answer: 1.0 se 4.0 min ke darmiyan NH₃ banne ki average rate 0.90 mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹ hai.

blocks.prompt: Hydrogen aur iodine se hydrogen iodide banta hai: H₂(g) + I₂(g) → 2HI(g). Reaction shuru hone ke 100.0 s baad iodine ki concentration 0.010 mol dm⁻³ se gir kar 0.0080 mol dm⁻³ ho gayi. Is time period mein average rate kya hai?

items: Instantaneous rate: ek instant ki rate (tangent ka slope); average rate: poore interval par change / time.
Haber misal: 3.0 min mein 2.7 mol dm⁻³, average rate 0.90 mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹.
